lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately seven visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a structured grid-like pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, functioning as anchor nodes for the grid across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal carinae are visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from high intensity on the dorsal edge to lower intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains approximately five high-luminance blobs of varying diameters, distributed non-uniformly across its surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of small-diameter, high-luminance spots is localized on the cranial region anterior to the gill slits, transitioning to larger, more sparse patterns on the trunk.
